title: Understanding Inequality of LLM Fact-Checking over Geographic Regions with Agent and Retrieval models
authors: Bruno Coelho; Shujaat Mirza; Yuyuan Cui; Christina Pöpper; Damon McCoy
why_relevant: Evaluates LLM fact-checking accuracy across regions with RAG and agent-based retrieval, touching on retrieval limitations for region-specific knowledge.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on geographic bias in fact-checking, not on robustness of RAG to unreliable evidence, conflict, or adversarial inputs.
